summary: Atour Lifestyle Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing its second quarter 2026 unaudited results, the US equivalent of a voluntary earnings release for a foreign private issuer. The company reported 2,175 hotels and 242,526 rooms operating as of June 30, 2026, up 19.2% and 18.4% year over year, with net revenues up 41.4% to RMB3,490 million (US$514 million) and net income up 29.0% to RMB548 million (US$81 million); retail revenue rose 63.2% to RMB1,575 million. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed; no special-situation or risk-arb angle applies.
